class_id: date text formatted in the zone of the running process instead of IST
feature: any date or time text rendered by web/components, web/app or web/lib through date-fns format()/formatISO()/formatRelative(), toLocaleDateString/toLocaleTimeString/toLocaleString with date fields, or Intl.DateTimeFormat without a timeZone
symptom: the VPS renders in UTC and the reader's browser in IST (or any zone), so the same component produces different text on the server and in the browser: React #418 hydration mismatch. The same code also prints a date one day off for part of every IST day when it formats an instant instead of an IST calendar day. Wider shape: any output that depends on the process environment (zone, locale, clock) rendered on two machines that must agree.
first_seen: 2026-10-01 -- IPODhan, issue #1347. /ipos/<slug> threw React #418 in the browser. Reproduced in a dev build: IPOScoreSection 'Calculated: Oct 01, 2026 03:10' (server, UTC) vs '08:40' (browser, IST); TimelineBase '06 Oct' (server, UTC) vs '05 Oct' (browser, America/Los_Angeles). PR #1378 round 1 fixed the 13 components found on that page; the Tier B review then found three more chart files the first sweep missed (OverallSubscriptionChart.tsx, SubscriptionDashboard/utils.ts, GMPHistoryChart/utils.ts), which is why round 2 sweeps by class, not by page. Count of remaining offenders measured 2026-10-01: 49 in 32 (file, kind) entries, listed in scripts/ci/unpinned-date-format-baseline.json.
fix_prs: #1378 (IST helpers in web/lib/utils/date-formatter.ts: formatIPODate, formatIstDateTime, formatInIst; hydration test web/tests/unit/components/ipo/hydration-host-timezone.test.tsx renders under TZ=UTC / Asia/Kolkata / America/Los_Angeles / Asia/Tokyo). Backlog of baselined offenders: #1390.
detection_check: scripts/ci/check-unpinned-date-format.mjs (PR gate `gate` job, .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml), self-test scripts/tests/check-unpinned-date-format.test.mjs. Parses with the TypeScript compiler and decides by import source (date-fns, any local alias or namespace), fails closed on re-exports, require/dynamic import, namespace escapes, bare Intl and unresolvable options. A new (file, kind) or a higher count fails; a count below its baseline also fails so the baseline cannot hide room. Known gap: a date in a variable with a non-date name formatted with toLocaleString() and no options is indistinguishable from a number without a type checker. Existing offenders are baselined with reasons, not fixed: status stays unguarded for them until #1390 closes.
